title: Transformation of Aspergillus niger Using Cas9 and AMA1 Vector
author: Laure Leynaud-Kieffer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wb8farw
materials: Preparation of the protoplast: -Freshly prepare 40 mL of 30 mg/mL VinoTaste Pro (from Novozymes) in Protoplasting Buffer (0.6 M ammonium sulfate and 50 mM maleic acid in ddH2O, pH adjusted to 5.5) (note: this can take a little while to go into solution so leave on stir-plate while harvesting the mycelia) -Filter-sterilize the VinoTaste Pro/Protoplasting Buffer solution using a 0.45 μm bottle-top vacuum filter -The overnight YPD culture of the A. niger strain was filtered through a single layer of sterilized Miracloth (from Millipore) using a Buchner funnel and gravity filtration system (into a sterile 500-mL glass bottle) -The mycelia retained on the Miracloth was rinsed with three times with 100 mL sterile ddH2O; the flow-through was discarded -The washed mycelia was then transferred to a sterile 250-mL glass flask containing 40 mL of the filter-sterilized solution of the VinoTaste Pro/Protoplasting Buffer solution -The digesting mycelia were incubated in a shaker set at 70 rpm at 30 °C for 4-6 hr; every 1-2 hr a small aliquot of the solutions was examined using a light microscope to detect the progress of protoplast formation

steps.title: Prepare DNA constructs and sgRNAs
steps.instruction: Prepare and verify the necessary genetic materials for transformation.

substeps.instruction: Amplify the pyrG marker construct using Phusion Hot Start II, purify, and concentrate to 1 ug/uL (10 ug required per transformation).
Prepare and concentrate the plasmid containing the Cas9 cassette, hygromycin marker, and AMA1 cassette to 1 ug/uL (1 ug required per transformation).
Verify sgRNAs in vitro using the Guide-it sgRNA Screening Kit (Takara).
Amplify validated sgRNAs by PCR using the GeneART gRNA synthesis protocol.

steps.title: Prepare selection media
steps.instruction: Prepare Minimal Media Agar (MMA) plates and liquid media.

substeps.instruction: Prepare MMA plates containing 10 g/L Glucose, 50 ml/L 20X Nitrate Salts Stock Solution, 1 ml/L 1000X Trace Elements Stock Solution, 1 ml/L 1000X Vitamins Stock Solution (pH 6.5 using KOH), 18 g/L Granulated Agar, 1M Sorbitol, and 300 ug/mL hygromycin.
Prepare positive and negative control plates.
Prepare 10 mL of liquid MMA containing hygromycin per transformation (including controls) and maintain at 60°C to keep liquid.

steps.title: Generate A. niger protoplasts
steps.instruction: Culture the strain and isolate protoplasts.

substeps.instruction: Harvest spores from A. niger (pyrG-) MMA agar slants using 0.2% Tween-20 solution and count with a hemocytometer.
Inoculate the strain at 5x10^5 spores/mL into 100 mL of YPD medium supplemented with 1.2 mg/mL uracil in a 250-mL glass flask.
Cap the flask and incubate overnight in a shaker at 150 rpm and 30°C.
Approximately 5 hours post-inoculation, decant the digested mycelia solution over a single layer of sterilized Miracloth in a 50-mL conical tube and discard the retained mycelia.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 800 rcf for 10 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend protoplasts
steps.instruction: Clean the protoplast pellet using ST and STC solutions.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ST Solution (1 M sorbitol in 50 mM Tris, pH 8.0) using a wide-bore pipette tip, add 25 mL ST Solution, centrifuge at 800 rcf for 10 min, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the wash process (1 mL then 25 mL ST Solution) and centrifuge at 800 rcf for 10 min, discarding the supernatant.
Resuspend the final pellet in 200 uL STC Solution (1 M sorbitol and 50 mM CaCl2 in 50 mM Tris, pH 8.0) using a wide-bore pipette tip and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA in vitro
steps.instruction: Transcribe and purify sgRNA from the template using the GeneART protocol.

substeps.instruction: Obtain a concentration between 5 ug/uL and 10 ug/uL.
Prepare 20 ug per transformation (either 20 ug for one sgRNA or 10 ug each for two sgRNAs) and keep on ice.

steps.title: Perform transformation
steps.instruction: Combine protoplasts with DNA and reagents for transformation.

substeps.instruction: In a 12 mL falcon tube, combine 100 uL of A. niger (pyrG-) protoplasts, 1 ug Cas9 plasmid (hph marker), 20 ug sgRNA(s), 10 ug pyrG construct, and 100 uL transformation solution (25% PEG 6000, 50 mM CaCl2, and 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5).
Incubate the mixture on ice for 20 min.
Add 2 mL of transformation solution and incubate for 5 min at room temperature (while cooling MMA + hph plates to ~45°C).
Add 4 mL STC and mix by gently inverting the tube several times.
Add 7 mL of molten top agar to the mixture, mix by pipetting, and immediately pour onto selection plates.
Incubate at 30°C for 4 days until sporulation.

steps.title: Isolate and verify transformants
steps.instruction: Select and screen colonies for successful integration.

substeps.instruction: Before the appearance of spores, scoop out colonies and isolate them on MMA slants (without hygromycin) to lose the Cas9 plasmid.

Once spores form on slants, isolate them on MMA plates containing 1.3 mg/mL 5-FOA and 1.2 mg/mL uracil (harvest spores in 100 uL 0.2% tween-20, dilute 1:10 into 100 uL, and plate 10 uL of the dilution).
Re-isolate growing colonies on MMA + 1.3 mg/mL 5-FOA + 1.2 mg/mL uracil plates.
Before the appearance of spores, scoop out colonies and place on slants containing MMA + 1.2 mg/mL uracil/uridine.
Isolate a minimum of 10 colonies per transformation and analyze via PCR and sequencing.
